headline: BOS @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 4.82 at COL 4.68, with a projected total of 9.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: BOS moved -0.61 runs while COL moved +0.35, changing the projected margin by -0.96 runs. NRFI probability rose +6.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Ryan Feltner has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for TJ Rumfield, Ceddanne Rafaela, Willi Castro, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Hunter Goodman, Jarren Duran because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
